derivation: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281 (θάλασσα)) the Red Sea

occurrences.text: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
